Package aor.proj3t.dto

Class TrainingDTO

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.dto.TrainingDTO
public class TrainingDTO extends Object
Data Transfer Object for Training entity.

Represents a structured training module including metadata, categorization, lifecycle timestamps, and status flags. This DTO facilitates the exchange of training-related data across REST APIs, client interfaces, and internal services. JAXB annotations allow for XML serialization in services that require it.

Attributes: - id: Unique identifier of the training entry - title: Name or headline of the training course - duration: Total duration of the training in minutes - description: Summary or content overview for the training - link: URL to training materials or platform - language: Language in which the training is provided (e.g. ENGLISH, SPANISH) - isActive: Indicates whether the training is currently available - createdAt: Timestamp of when the training was created - editedAt: Timestamp of the most recent modification - trainingArea: Category or thematic area the training belongs to Use cases: - Displaying available trainings to users - Admin dashboard for managing training catalog - Exporting or syncing training records across systems
